summary_en: Interim dividend of 21 yen per share confirmed for September 30, 2026 base date. Year-end dividend forecast revised upward by 6 yen to 27 yen per share for March 31, 2027 base date, bringing full-year dividend to 48 yen per share from prior forecast of 42 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend on Surplus (Implementation of Interim Dividend) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Kawada Technologies announced revisions to its dividend forecast on November 10, 2026. The interim dividend for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, with a base date of September 30, 2026, was confirmed at 21 yen per share, unchanged from the previous forecast announced on May 12, 2026. The year-end dividend forecast was revised upward by 6 yen to 27 yen per share, with a base date of March 31, 2027. This brings the full-year dividend for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 to 48 yen per share, compared to the previously forecast 42 yen.

The company's basic dividend policy targets a consolidated payout ratio of approximately 30 percent while maintaining stable distributions. The revision reflected the company's updated earnings forecast announced on the same date, considering both business performance and future capital requirements for business expansion, equipment investment, and research and development activities, alongside improvements in financial condition. The prior fiscal year (ended March 31, 2026) saw annual dividends of 151 yen per share on an unadjusted basis, though the company executed a 3-for-1 stock split effective April 1, 2026.
